name: University of Graz
summary: Graz's public general university; all its bachelor's are taught in German, and IB German at HL meets its language rule.

ib.text: 24+ points, three HL totalling 12+, no grade below 3; two languages, a humanities subject, a science and maths. German at HL meets the German rule; otherwise you need a C1 certificate.

notes: With German at A2 you can be admitted to a preparation programme first, but you must reach C1 before you start the degree.
When you open your application account, choose the entrance qualification "46 - IB Diploma (foreign country)".
